display.purpose: KPI values, board counters, single headline numbers. Barlow Condensed, tabular numerals.

headline.purpose: Page titles inside hero bands and section headers.

body.purpose: UI copy, instructions, descriptions. Thai keeps line-height >= 1.6.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-heads: table headers, stat labels, mobile data-labels.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus glow on interactive elements.

motion.name: ease-slow
motion.purpose: Andon lamp color changes, broader fades.

motion.name: signal-blink
motion.purpose: Red Andon alarm blink only; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Tables collapse to stacked cards; dialogs become bottom sheets.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Login stacks, mobile card redesign, full-bleed 48px inputs.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Top app bar + bottom nav swap to desktop sidebar + topbar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single flat Toppan blue action — the only blue pop on a screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">บันทึกใบแจ้งซ่อม</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:12px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#FFFFFF; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#0068B5; border:1px solid transparent; box-shadow:0 4px 14px -8px rgba(0,104,181,.45); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#005FA3; box-shadow:none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0068B5; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Success Button
components.description: Green fill for actions that complete work — sync, close work order, finish checklists.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-success">บันทึกผลตรวจ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:12px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#FFFFFF; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-success { background:#16A34A; border:1px solid transparent; box-shadow:0 4px 14px -8px rgba(22,163,74,.45); } .ds-btn-success:hover { background:#15803D; box-shadow:none; } .ds-btn-success:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #16A34A; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-success:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Red fill for destructive or stop-state actions; never decorative.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:12px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#FFFFFF; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger { background:#DC2626; border:1px solid transparent; box-shadow:0 4px 14px -8px rgba(220,38,38,.45); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#B91C1C; box-shadow:none; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #DC2626; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: White field, 8px radius, focus glow ring. 48px and 16px font on phones to kill iOS zoom.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-label" for="n1">เลขครุภัณฑ์</label><input class="ds-input" id="n1" type="text" placeholder="SAC-1042">
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:48px; min-height:48px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #D4D4D8; border-radius:8px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#18181B; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:16px; transition:border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#A1A1AA; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#0068B5; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,104,181,.18); } .ds-input:disabled { background:#F4F4F5; color:#A1A1AA; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-input-label { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; color:#52525B; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white surface with a hairline and ambient shadow; KPI cards add a 2px semantic rail.
components.html:
ระดับน้ำมันเครื่อง
ตรวจเช็คทุกกะก่อนเริ่มงาน
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius:12px; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(24,24,27,.07), 0 1px 2px rgba(24,24,27,.04); transition:box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 6px; font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#18181B; } .ds-card-text { margin:0; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.6; color:#52525B; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill status with the Andon lamp vocabulary — green/amber/red mean machine health.
components.html: พร้อมใช้งาน
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:9999px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip-dot { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-chip-ok { color:#16A34A; } .ds-chip-ok .ds-chip-dot { background:#10B981; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(16,185,129,.5); } .ds-chip-warn { color:#D97706; } .ds-chip-warn .ds-chip-dot { background:#F59E0B; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(245,158,11,.5); } .ds-chip-down { color:#DC2626; } .ds-chip-down .ds-chip-dot { background:#EF4444; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(239,68,68,.6); } .ds-chip-idle { color:#52525B; } .ds-chip-idle .ds-chip-dot { background:#94A3B8; }

components.name: Andon Lamp Stack
components.description: The signature 3-lamp machine-health signal — red/amber/green, lit lamp glows, red blinks.
components.css: .ds-andon { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:3px; padding:5px 4px; background:rgba(127,141,170,.14); border:1px solid rgba(127,141,170,.14); border-radius:7px; } .ds-andon-lamp { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(127,141,170,.28); transition:background .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; } .ds-andon-ok .ds-andon-lamp:nth-child(3) { background:#10B981; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(16,185,129,.55); } .ds-andon-warn .ds-andon-lamp:nth-child(2) { background:#F59E0B; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(245,158,11,.55); } .ds-andon-down .ds-andon-lamp:nth-child(1) { background:#EF4444; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.6); animation:dsAndonBlink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsAndonBlink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.45} } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .ds-andon-down .ds-andon-lamp:nth-child(1){ animation:none; } }

components.name: KPI Value
components.description: The loudest voice — Barlow Condensed tabular numeral over a stat label.
components.css: .ds-kpi-value { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:2.15rem; line-height:1; letter-spacing:.01em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#18181B; } .ds-kpi-unit { font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Noto Sans Thai',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:500; color:#52525B; } .ds-kpi-label { margin-top:6px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:500; color:#52525B; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: Active rail item — flat Toppan blue fill, white text, with the 5px indicator dot.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#52525B; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#F4F5F7; } .ds-nav-icon { width:18px; height:18px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-nav-active { background:#0068B5; color:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,87,168,.35); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background:#0068B5; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0068B5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Machine Select Chip
components.description: Tactile floor selector — heavy hairline, flat blue when chosen, presses like a key.
components.css: .ds-mchip { border:1.5px solid #E4E4E7; background:#FFFFFF; color:#18181B; border-radius:12px; padding:12px 8px; font-family:'Roboto','Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; touch-action:manipulation; transition:all 120ms ease; } .ds-mchip:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-mchip-selected { background:#0068B5; border-color:#0068B5; color:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,104,181,.22); } .ds-mchip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0068B5; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like the machine room of plant maintenance: a calm surface that speaks in signals, not slogans. It inherits the motifs a technician already reads on the physical floor — the Andon signal stack on the machine, part numbers printed in condensed block type, the blue laminated standard tag on calibrated equipment — and renders them as a software control panel. TOPPAN blue (#0068B5) is the single calibrated interactive accent, used the way it is in the source world: a subdued, precise indicator of where a technician can act. Numbers are the loudest voice, set in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals so columns of figures align like readouts that glance-diff at arm's length. Everything else is quiet: zinc neutrals, flat surfaces, one-pixel hairlines, a dry depth vocabulary. Dialogs, toasts, and the command palette float; the rest rests. The PWA App Shell is the frame — 56px top bar and bottom nav on phones, 260px sidebar on desktop — sized for gloved thumbs and full-brightness field light, and offline-first by operating truth.
keyCharacteristics: Machine-health color grammar: green / amber / red mean what they mean on the Andon pole, everywhere in the app
Barlow Condensed numerals for every measurement; Thai and body copy in Roboto / Noto Sans Thai with ≥1.6 line-height
Flat surfaces separated by 1px hairlines; shadows reserved for floating layers and KPI lifts
TOPPAN blue appears at most a few times per screen, always meaning "act"
Touch targets ≥48px, dark-mode aware, prefers-reduced-motion respected end-to-end

rules.name: The Andon Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red mean machine and process health — nothing else. If a color is not signaling a state change, it does not earn a signal color.

rules.name: The Calibrated Blue Rule
rules.body: Toppan blue is the only interactive accent. On any given screen it covers no more than ~10% of visible surface.

rules.name: The Flat-Alloy Rule
rules.body: Blue on white is always a flat fill. Gradients belong to the navy console (hero headers, Andon board, login band) and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Every numeric measure is set in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals so figures align like instrument readouts.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type and body type never trade roles. Headings get Barlow; paragraphs, controls, and instructions get Roboto/Noto Sans Thai.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase micro-labels are the only label layer, always Barlow 600, and never sit above a heading alone.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting separation is always a hairline or a tonal step — never a shadow. Shadow appears as a response to hover, float, or importance.

dos: Do reserve Toppan blue for exactly one interactive thing per view.
Do set every number in Barlow Condensed tabular numerals.
Do let green/amber/red mean machine health via the Andon vocabulary.
Do keep resting surfaces flat with a 1px hairline; reach for shadow only to lift a floating layer or answer a hover.
Do keep touch targets ≥48px and form inputs 48px/16px on phones.
Do give every interactive element a 3px primary glow ring on focus-visible.
Do round dialogs 16–20px and seat mobile bottom sheets at the screen edge.
donts: Don't run gradients on white surfaces — buttons, icon tiles, list rails, or callout strips.
Don't decorate with a signal color; amber and red are earned by state.
Don't give a card a border and a wide shadow at once — the ghost-card double separation.
Don't set Thai or paragraph text in the display face, and don't clip Thai descenders with tight line-heights.
Don't use monospace as a mood for "technical"; codes and WO IDs may be monospace, body copy may not.
Don't animate the red Andon lamp when prefers-reduced-motion is on.
Don't let an eyebrow label float above a heading.
